budget.notes: Cross-agent comparison profile: same provider (deepseek), same model (deepseek-flash), thinking off, fixed sampling temperature 0 and a per-request output cap of 8192 tokens, the same mio-workflows-v1 task set and the same 180s per-task wall timeout as evals/configs/pi-deepseek-comparison.json. deepseek-flash is the model both agents actually list; the older deepseek-chat profile in evals/configs/mio-deepseek.json is left unchanged. No model-call or token cap is set on either side: Pi cannot enforce one, so this side deliberately mirrors that instead of claiming a token hard budget. Only the runner's wall-clock timeout is enforced; the budget block stays declared metadata. The declared temperature and output cap are not just metadata: Mio sends them on every request through --temperature 0 and --max-output-tokens 8192. Context discovery, MCP and skills/prompt templates are disabled to match Pi's flags. Credentials come from the environment only (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY); never put a key in this file or the command.
